description: One framework, multiple languages — build modern backends with Fusion across Node.js, Python, and C#.

features.title: Everything you need to ship APIs
features.description: A shared Rust core, thin language bindings, and a class-based module model — the same HTTP semantics everywhere you work.

items.title: Shared Rust core
items.description: HTTP serving, routing, settings, and serialization live once in fusion-core — bindings stay focused on developer experience.

items.title: Class-based APIs
items.description: Define modules as FusionBaseApi classes, register routes explicitly, and keep each resource surface owned by one module.

items.title: Router & middleware
items.description: Compose request pipelines with the same routing model across Python, TypeScript, and C#.

items.title: Fusion Tool CLI
items.description: Scaffold apps, manage environments, and install reusable packages with the official fusion binary.

items.title: FMA modules
items.description: Compose applications from route modules and publishable packages — clear boundaries between HTTP surface and shared libraries.

items.title: OpenAPI ready
items.description: Generate API docs from your modules so clients and teammates stay aligned with the live surface.

languages.title: One mental model. Three runtimes.
languages.description: Write idiomatic Python, TypeScript, or C# against the same Fusion concepts — install, scaffold, and ship.

poweredBy.title: Powered by three languages. One shared core.

items.name: C#

benchmarks.title: Performance starts in the core
benchmarks.description: Fusion keeps the hot path in Rust while language bindings stay thin. You get one routing model, consistent headers and status helpers, and less framework drift between teams.

pillars.title: Native serving path
pillars.description: Hyper-backed serving, routing tokens, and response serialization are implemented once — not reimplemented per language.

pillars.title: Thin bindings
pillars.description: Python, Node, and C# mirror the same HTTP semantics with idiomatic syntax instead of shipping three divergent frameworks.

pillars.title: Predictable DX
pillars.description: Config, middleware, pagination, status codes, and headers follow the same concepts across every official binding.

workflow.title: From zero to a running API
workflow.description: Scaffold with Fusion Tool, install the binding for your language, define a module, and listen.

steps.title: Install
steps.description: Add fusion-framework (or Fusion-Framework on NuGet) for your runtime.

steps.title: Define modules
steps.description: Own each resource with a FusionBaseApi class and explicit route registration.

steps.title: Ship
steps.description: Compose middleware, configure environments, and grow with reusable packages.
